title: 야 이거 봤어
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop funk-pop fusion. Slap bass performs syncopated sixteenth-note patterns. Bright, clean electric guitar plays percussive muted strums and disco-style chords. Brass section provides staccato stabs on the off-beats. Electronic drums feature a crisp snare and a tight kick. Synthesizers include shimmering pads and a high-pitched lead melody. Male vocals utilize a mix of chest voice and falsetto with rhythmic delivery. Key of G Major. Tempo 124 BPM. 4/4 time signature.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[slap bass, clean electric guitar, electronic drums]
[brass stabs]

[Verse 1]
[male vocals]
금요일 밤 열시야
소파에 파묻혀
리모컨 눌러 채널 돌려
예능이 시작해
웃기다 진짜 웃겨 [brass stab]

[Pre-Chorus]
캡처 눌러 톡에 올려
삼초 만에 답 와
보고 있었네 너도
같이 봐 우리
배꼽 잡아야 해

[Chorus]
[full band, high-energy]
야 이거 봤어? [cymbal crash]
방금 그 장면
웃겨 죽겠어
같이 웃으니까 금요일이야
